effect_on_model: Strict governor edges remain promoted candidates. 820 portability gains source-peek support. 002-861 has a compatible source witness but remains leaky/near because its corpus terminality is lower than strict closures.
why_not_accepted: A spot audit is not enough: it does not box token boundaries, does not sample every site/type stratum, and does not independently resegment signs from high-resolution plates.
